description: This is the main application component for an Angular-based notes organizer web application. It manages the core logic of loading, displaying, and updating notes, as well as handling user interactions like selecting, creating, updating, and deleting notes. The component includes template HTML, component styles, and TypeScript logic for data binding and service calls.

classes.name: AppComponent
classes.description: Main Angular component managing note operations and user interface for the notes organizer app.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component by loading all notes when the app starts.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Fetches all notes from the notes service and updates the local notes array.

methods.name: onNoteSelected
methods.description: Handles the event when a note is selected from the list, fetching the note details.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Performs a search based on the user's query, updating the displayed notes.

methods.name: onNoteUpdated
methods.description: Updates note content via the notes service and refreshes the notes list.

methods.name: onNoteDeleted
methods.description: Deletes a note and refreshes the list.

methods.name: onCreateNew
methods.description: Creates a new note and sets it as the selected note.

methods.name: handleApiError
methods.description: Sets the error message based on the caught error during API calls.
